# Synthetic numeric dimension fixture

`dimension25.bin` and `dimension25.cfb` cover the supported aligned numeric
measurement-ratio profile. Tests distinguish numeric values from displayed
text and reject unsupported selectors, malformed structure, and invalid ratios.

The construction is in `scripts/make_dimension_fixture.py`. The data uses the
project's PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0. It does not establish immutable
creation scale or nearby geometry units.
